title: TUX RACER
subtitle: Sunspire Studios, 2001 · 0.61, the last GPL release — GLUT, Tcl 8.4 for its courses, its terrain in C++

needsData.hint: tuxracer-data-0.61/ from the game's data archive (courses, textures, fonts, tux.tcl)

_why: The first game here whose C++ is part of the game: the course is a quadtree (quadtree.cpp, 1,580 lines of classes) compiled by src/cxx beside 70 C files, and its courses are Tcl scripts run by the real Tcl 8.4 library, built from source like the rest. GLU and the input half of GLUT were written for it.
_fps: The page's own cap: GLUT has none, and the game draws as fast as it is allowed.
